// The parent driver runs these only in its isolated *_test database. Each test
// has its own schema, built from the actual ordered owner migration sources.
func TestT13PendingAssistanceRetention(t *testing.T) {
	for _, contextType := range []domain.LearningContextType{domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, domain.LearningContextProject} {
		for _, path := range []string{"block", "unknown", "partial", "committed_unreconciled", "transactional reconciliation"} {
			t.Run(string(contextType)+"/"+path, func(t *testing.T) {
				pool := migration023IntegrationPool(t, 25)
				job, decision, body := t13GeneratedJob(t, pool, contextType)
				store := TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: pool}
				now := job.UpdatedAt.Add(time.Second)
				switch path {
				case "block":
					require.NoError(t, store.Block(context.Background(), job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDelivery, now))
				case "transactional reconciliation":
					tx, err := pool.Begin(context.Background())
					require.NoError(t, err)
					defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(context.Background()) }()
					require.NoError(t, store.markReconciliationTx(context.Background(), tx, job.Request.EventID, "partial", domain.TeacherDialogErrorDelivery, now))
				default:
					require.NoError(t, store.MarkReconciliation(context.Background(), job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherTurnReconciliationState(path), domain.TeacherDialogErrorDelivery, now))
				}
				// A newly constructed repository must read the same private body/decision.
				reconstructed := TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: pool}
				retained, err := reconstructed.getByEventID(context.Background(), job.Request.EventID)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, sha256.Sum256([]byte(body)), sha256.Sum256([]byte(retained.ResponseBody)), "pending body digest changed")
				require.Equal(t, len(body), len(retained.ResponseBody))
				require.Equal(t, decision.ID, retained.DecisionID)
				require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogJobBlocked, retained.Status)
				require.Empty(t, retained.ClaimToken)
				require.Empty(t, retained.DeliveredMessageID)
				require.True(t, retained.DeliveredAt.IsZero())
				_, claimed, err := reconstructed.Claim(context.Background(), jobrepository.TeacherDialogClaim{ClaimToken: uuid.NewString(), WorkerID: "t13-retention", Now: now.Add(time.Hour), LockedUntil: now.Add(2 * time.Hour)})
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.False(t, claimed, "retention must not unblock or retry")
				var decisions, outbox int
				require.NoError(t, pool.QueryRow(context.Background(), `SELECT count(*) FROM teacher_decision WHERE id=$1`, decision.ID).Scan(&decisions))
				require.NoError(t, pool.QueryRow(context.Background(), `SELECT count(*) FROM teacher_outbox WHERE event_id=$1`, job.Request.EventID).Scan(&outbox))
				require.Equal(t, 1, decisions)
				require.Equal(t, 1, outbox)
				err = execT13PendingMigration(context.Background(), pool, t13PendingMigrationSQL(t, ".down.sql"))
				require.ErrorContains(t, err, "025 rollback refused")
				retained, err = reconstructed.getByEventID(context.Background(), job.Request.EventID)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, sha256.Sum256([]byte(body)), sha256.Sum256([]byte(retained.ResponseBody)))
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestT13PendingMigrationUpDownUpAndNarrowConstraint(t *testing.T) {
	pool := migration023IntegrationPool(t, 24)
	ctx := context.Background()
	var original string
	require.NoError(t, pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT pg_get_constraintdef(oid) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='teacher_dialog_job'::regclass AND conname='teacher_dialog_job_shape_check'`).Scan(&original))
	require.NoError(t, execT13PendingMigration(ctx, pool, t13PendingMigrationSQL(t, ".up.sql")))
	require.NoError(t, execT13PendingMigration(ctx, pool, t13PendingMigrationSQL(t, ".down.sql")))
	var restored string
	require.NoError(t, pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT pg_get_constraintdef(oid) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='teacher_dialog_job'::regclass AND conname='teacher_dialog_job_shape_check'`).Scan(&restored))
	require.Equal(t, original, restored, "down must restore the actual prior constraint")
	require.NoError(t, execT13PendingMigration(ctx, pool, t13PendingMigrationSQL(t, ".up.sql")))
	job, _, body := t13GeneratedJob(t, pool, domain.LearningContextPracticeTask)
	store := TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: pool}
	require.NoError(t, store.Block(ctx, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDelivery, job.UpdatedAt.Add(time.Second)))
	for _, sql := range []string{
		`UPDATE teacher_dialog_job SET context_type='lesson_task' WHERE event_id=$1`,
		`UPDATE teacher_dialog_job SET coordinator_mode='onboarding_text' WHERE event_id=$1`,
		`UPDATE teacher_dialog_job SET decision_id=NULL WHERE event_id=$1`,
		`UPDATE teacher_dialog_job SET attempts=0 WHERE event_id=$1`,
		`UPDATE teacher_dialog_job SET delivered_message_id=event_id,teacher_response_message_id=event_id,reconciliation_state='committed_unreconciled' WHERE event_id=$1`,
		`UPDATE teacher_dialog_job SET response_body=repeat('x',12001) WHERE event_id=$1`,
		`UPDATE teacher_dialog_job SET response_body=repeat('x',48001) WHERE event_id=$1`,
		`UPDATE teacher_dialog_job SET response_body=' ' WHERE event_id=$1`,
	} {
		_, err := pool.Exec(ctx, sql, job.Request.EventID)
		require.Error(t, err, "illegal retained body shape accepted")
	}
	retained, err := store.getByEventID(ctx, job.Request.EventID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, sha256.Sum256([]byte(body)), sha256.Sum256([]byte(retained.ResponseBody)))
	var migrations int
	require.NoError(t, pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='teacher_dialog_job'::regclass AND conname IN ('teacher_dialog_job_shape_check','teacher_dialog_job_response_body_check')`).Scan(&migrations))
	require.Equal(t, 2, migrations, "both shape and existing byte bound remain installed")
}

func TestT13DeliveredBodyClearsAndOtherContextBlockSemanticsRemain(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"verified delivery", "known committed append", "other context", "coordinator", "ungenerated"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			pool := migration023IntegrationPool(t, 25)
			ctx := context.Background()
			contextType := domain.LearningContextPracticeTask
			if mode == "other context" {
				contextType = domain.LearningContextLessonTask
			}
			job, _, _ := t13GeneratedJob(t, pool, contextType)
			store := TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: pool}
			now := job.UpdatedAt.Add(time.Second)
			switch mode {
			case "verified delivery":
				require.NoError(t, store.CompleteDelivery(ctx, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, uuid.NewString(), now))
			case "known committed append":
				tx, err := pool.Begin(ctx)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
				require.ErrorIs(t, store.blockCommittedUnreconciled(ctx, tx, job.Request.EventID, uuid.NewString(), now), domain.ErrTeacherDialogCursorBlocked)
			case "coordinator":
				_, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_dialog_job SET coordinator_mode='onboarding_text',decision_id=NULL WHERE event_id=$1`, job.Request.EventID)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.NoError(t, store.MarkReconciliation(ctx, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherTurnUnknown, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDelivery, now))
			case "ungenerated":
				_, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_dialog_job SET decision_id=NULL,response_body=NULL WHERE event_id=$1`, job.Request.EventID)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.NoError(t, store.Block(ctx, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDelivery, now))
			default:
				require.NoError(t, store.Block(ctx, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDelivery, now))
			}
			read, err := store.getByEventID(ctx, job.Request.EventID)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Zero(t, len(read.ResponseBody))
			if mode == "verified delivery" {
				require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogJobDelivered, read.Status)
				require.NotEmpty(t, read.DeliveredMessageID)
			} else {
				require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogJobBlocked, read.Status)
			}
		})
	}
}

func t13GeneratedJob(t *testing.T, pool *pgxpool.Pool, contextType domain.LearningContextType) (domain.TeacherDialogJob, domain.TeacherDecision, string) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	studentID, teacherID := insertMigration023Teacher(t, pool)
	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 4, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	request := domain.DialogTeacherRequest{SchemaVersion: 1, EventID: uuid.NewString(), DialogID: uuid.NewString(), EventSequence: 1, SourceMessageID: uuid.NewString(), SourceSequence: 1, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: contextType, ContextID: uuid.NewString(), LearningActionID: uuid.NewString(), SourceChannel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, OccurredAt: now}
	job, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogJob(request, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	store := TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: pool}
	accepted, err := store.Accept(ctx, job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, accepted)
	claimed, ok, err := store.Claim(ctx, jobrepository.TeacherDialogClaim{ClaimToken: uuid.NewString(), WorkerID: "t13-retention", Now: now, LockedUntil: now.Add(time.Minute)})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, ok)
	fixture := &teacherDecisionIntegrationFixture{pool: pool, studentID: studentID, teacherID: teacherID}
	decision, event := fixture.decision(uuid.NewString(), request.EventID, contextType, request.ContextID, request.LearningActionID, request.LearningActionID)
	body := strings.Repeat("界", 12000) // exact rune boundary; 36000 UTF-8 bytes
	require.NoError(t, store.SaveGenerated(ctx, request.EventID, claimed.ClaimToken, decision, event, body, uuid.NewString(), now))
	return claimed, decision, body
}

func t13PendingMigrationSQL(t *testing.T, suffix string) string {
	t.Helper()
	content, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(migration019RepositoryRoot(t), "db", "migrations", "025_practice_assistance_pending_response"+suffix))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return string(content)
}

func execT13PendingMigration(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, sql string) error {
	connection, err := pool.Acquire(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer connection.Release()
	_, err = connection.Exec(ctx, sql)
	if err != nil {
		_, _ = connection.Exec(ctx, "ROLLBACK")
	}
	return err
}

func TestT13PendingMigrationRegisteredProvenance(t *testing.T) {
	root := migration019RepositoryRoot(t)
	manifestPath := filepath.Join(root, ".ai", "testing", "teacher-test-migrations.v1.json")
	manifestBody, err := os.ReadFile(manifestPath)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var manifest struct {
		Migrations []struct {
			Path   string `json:"path"`
			SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
		} `json:"migrations"`
	}
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(manifestBody, &manifest))
	paths, err := migrationUpPathsThrough(root, 25)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Len(t, manifest.Migrations, len(paths))
	require.Equal(t, "db/migrations/025_practice_assistance_pending_response.up.sql", manifest.Migrations[len(manifest.Migrations)-1].Path)
	for index, path := range paths {
		relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, path)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, relative, manifest.Migrations[index].Path)
		body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(body)), manifest.Migrations[index].SHA256, "owner migration source changed")
	}
	latestHash := manifest.Migrations[len(manifest.Migrations)-1].SHA256
	for _, suite := range []string{"integration", "migration"} {
		body, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, ".ai", "testing", "disposable-postgres-"+suite+".v1.json"))
		require.NoError(t, err)
		var descriptor struct {
			Lifecycle struct {
				Readiness struct {
					Assertion string `json:"semantic_assertion"`
				} `json:"readiness"`
			} `json:"lifecycle"`
		}
		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(body, &descriptor))
		require.Contains(t, descriptor.Lifecycle.Readiness.Assertion, "latest migration 025")
		require.Contains(t, descriptor.Lifecycle.Readiness.Assertion, "sha256="+latestHash)
		require.Contains(t, descriptor.Lifecycle.Readiness.Assertion, "teacher-test-migrations.v1.json sha256="+fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(manifestBody)))
	}
}
